scope: Reviewed diagnostic questions and reversible checks; no authenticated guide content or private Discord history.

questions.platform: Which platform, device model and OS version are you using? Please leave out device identifiers.
questions.version: What is the full Torve version, and is it the public release or a beta build?
questions.expected: What did you expect to happen, and what actually happened?
questions.scope: Does this affect one item or every item you have tried?
questions.error: What exact error appears? Remove account details, stream URLs and credentials.
questions.video_audio: Does audio continue when the picture fails? Do subtitles or playback controls still work?
questions.source_type: Which connection type is affected, such as IPTV, a library connection or an add-on? Do not share its address or login.
questions.sync_devices: Which two devices are you comparing, and which watch state, list or preference differs?
questions.sync_scope: Does the difference affect one title or several, and when did you first notice it?
questions.reproduce: What short sequence of safe steps reproduces the problem?
questions.checks_tried: What have you already tried, and what happened after each check?
questions.install_stage: Which installation step fails, and what message does the device show?
questions.feature: What would you like Torve to do, and how would that help your workflow?

second_item.text: Try a second item you are authorised to play and compare whether the same symptom occurs. This helps distinguish one source from a wider playback problem.

restart_app.text: Close and reopen Torve, then repeat the same safe steps once. Do not clear app data, uninstall or reset your device for this check.

current_release.text: Compare your full Torve version with the official download page. Record your installed version before making any change, and keep beta/public build differences clear.

source_status.text: Check the connected service's own status page or app. Report whether the same item works there; do not send its URL, credentials or media files.

same_account.text: For account-backed sync, confirm that both devices are signed in to the same Torve account. Tell me only whether they match; never post the account email or password.

compare_devices.text: Repeat the same action with the same authorised item on the other device. Compare the app versions and the result without sharing account identifiers.

firetv_guide.text: Compare the failing step with the official Fire TV installation page, including whether the device uses compatible Android-based Fire OS or Vega OS. Do not bypass device security warnings.
